notes.content:

Expert

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333535/38a5b10e2a5ad0280b7b1361a1b144c2405fd0de.png


New Achievement!
Single Split Experiment
To put simply, if you can solve Single Split, you will get this achievement!
https://i.imgur.com/ErHTSfW.png


Last but not least... Russian language support!
Добро пожаловать, игроки!
The game is now fully translated into Russian! If you find any weird wordings or bugs with the UI, please let us know!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333535/3a2d3a3f2c5b58681fa6855db5daa903ab87ab5a.png


Minor patches and bug fixes
- Level Restart button now works again
- Adjusted UI style and spacing to be more consistent and flexible for multi-lingual support
- New "Share" tab in level editor that allows you to more easily import/copy level data
- Indicator to restart the game when certain options that requires a restart is changed
- Improved popup visuals
- Steam depot is now split for Linux and Windows - Meaning smaller download size as only the files relevant for the version will be downloaded!
